_comment: GPU session 5 (round 7): viral bases and the features that start from them (Shots boards, transitions, edits, a face-only re-shoot, dubs), the new moves and effects, seamless loops and a product spin, then every untested move at Draft. Blocks: v1 (features), v2 (moves and effects), v3 (loops), v4 (the moves wall).

takes.name: v1c-oskar-skate-dolly
takes.subject: Oskar, a seventy-year-old fisherman with a white beard and a navy knit cap, stands on a skateboard at the start of the harbour pier at golden hour, gulls on the railings
